answers.questionText: Which AWS AI managed service converts text inputs into lifelike speech audio?
answers.actualAnswerText: Amazon Polly converts text into lifelike speech audio using AWS-managed voices across many languages and styles.

answers.questionText: Which AWS AI managed service lets you build conversational chatbots using automatic speech recognition and NLP?
answers.actualAnswerText: Amazon Lex is the conversational AI service for building chatbots that combine automatic speech recognition and natural language understanding.

answers.questionText: What pricing dimension does Amazon Transcribe use for its speech-to-text service?
answers.actualAnswerText: Amazon Transcribe charges per audio minute processed, with cost scaling by features such as standard or custom models.

answers.questionText: Which AWS AI managed service translates text between languages using neural machine translation?
answers.actualAnswerText: Amazon Translate is the neural machine translation service that translates text between languages using AWS-managed models.

answers.questionText: How do you typically pay for Amazon Lookout for Metrics?
answers.actualAnswerText: Amazon Lookout for Metrics pricing is based on the number of metrics you monitor per month, with rates that scale by usage tier.

answers.questionText: Which AWS AI managed service handles NLP tasks such as sentiment analysis and custom entity recognition?
answers.actualAnswerText: Amazon Comprehend processes natural language for sentiment, key phrases, entity recognition, and supports custom classification and entity models.

answers.questionText: How does Amazon Lex typically charge for bot interactions?
answers.actualAnswerText: Amazon Lex pricing is per request, with text and voice interactions priced differently and rates varying by region.

answers.questionText: What pricing dimension best describes Amazon Textract usage?
answers.actualAnswerText: Amazon Textract charges per page or document processed, depending on which Textract API you call.

answers.questionText: Which AWS AI managed service extracts text, tables, and forms from scanned documents?
answers.actualAnswerText: Amazon Textract extracts text, tables, and forms from scanned documents and PDFs using managed document-understanding models.

answers.questionText: What core capability does Amazon Kendra provide within AWS AI Managed Services?
answers.actualAnswerText: Amazon Kendra delivers semantic enterprise search across sources like Amazon S3, SharePoint, and databases.

answers.questionText: Which AWS AI managed service orchestrates human review workflows for low-confidence predictions from ML services?
answers.actualAnswerText: Amazon Augmented AI (A2I) orchestrates human review workflows to handle low-confidence predictions generated by services like Textract or Rekognition.

answers.questionText: Which AWS managed service gives you specialized ML hardware such as AWS Trainium and AWS Inferentia instances?
answers.actualAnswerText: AWS provides specialized ML hardware through services like AWS Trainium and AWS Inferentia instances, letting you build custom ML infrastructure rather than using a fully managed model service.

answers.questionText: What security responsibilities accompany using AWS Trainium or AWS Inferentia hardware for AI workloads?
answers.actualAnswerText: When you use AWS Trainium or AWS Inferentia infrastructure, you handle full-stack security: VPC isolation, IAM on EC2, encrypted storage, secure access, and network segmentation.

answers.questionText: Which AWS AI managed service helps you build and deploy fraud detection models from your event data?
answers.actualAnswerText: Amazon Fraud Detector helps build, train, and deploy fraud detection models using your event data and managed features.

answers.questionText: Which AWS AI managed service family, such as Amazon Q-Business and Amazon Q-Apps, provides generative AI capabilities over enterprise data?
answers.actualAnswerText: Amazon Q services (including Q-Business, Q-Apps, and Q-Developer) offer managed generative AI experiences that apply AWS’s large language models to your enterprise data and applications.

answers.questionText: Which AWS AI managed service analyzes images and videos for objects, faces, and text?
answers.actualAnswerText: Amazon Rekognition analyzes images and videos to detect objects, scenes, faces, text, and even supports custom labels.

answers.questionText: Which AWS AI managed service converts audio to text for batch and streaming workloads?
answers.actualAnswerText: Amazon Transcribe converts audio into text for both streaming and batch workloads, offering features like custom vocabularies.

answers.questionText: Which AWS AI managed service builds personalized recommendations using your interaction data?
answers.actualAnswerText: Amazon Personalize ingests user-item interaction data to train models and deliver real-time personalized recommendations.
